long_biography.plain_text:
His automotive group began as the United Arab Emirates developed its modern commercial infrastructure. Saeed Mohammed al-Ghandi built the business around imported vehicles and equipment, creating separate operations for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, machinery and aftersales support. Daily management later passed to the next generation while he remained its founder and controlling family principal.

In the Federal National Council, al-Ghandi represented Dubai and was elected speaker, presiding over debates on federal legislation. He also chaired Dubai’s rent tribunal, served on the emirate’s economic council and held banking and housing-programme board roles.
